mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 0.1% signals an aggressive monetary easing policy that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.1%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in unemployment rate above 6.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE > 6.0%, or Rank IC over 3-year windows falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts below 950 thousand units and retail sales below 430,000 million dollars indicate broad-based consumer demand contraction, triggering negative equity valuations and S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when HOUST < 950 and RSAFS < 430000, or joint Rank IC falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.0%) triggers aggressive monetary tightening by the Federal Reserve, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 3.0%, or Rank IC over 3-year windows remains below 0.03.
